'''Final Rest''' was narrow, flat plateau that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], about 100 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]], and it was one of the highest points on the entire planet. The plateau was situated in a region of the world that was controlled by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the plateau became the site of the [[Deluge Control|control center]] of the [[Deluge Experiment]], an effort by the CSA to flood the surface of Nyriaan.
